title: GND population interchange format (D-10)
description: Draft 2020-12 schema for population files — the universal interchange for agent outputs, synthetic data, and eval fixtures (YAML or JSON, one loader: D-11). The `population` header carries declarative metadata: `model` (a reference the loader NEVER opens — T-01-05), `source`, optional `label`, optional `model_id`, and the declared fact-type `covers` used for vacuity detection (D-12). `model_id` (D-06) is the model's own top-level `model_id`, restated here so a population can say which model it was written for: when both the model and the population declare one and they DIFFER, the population is rejected at load (exit 3); when only the model declares one, the cross-check is skipped with a warning and acceptance is NOT withheld; when neither does, there is no check. It is compared as an opaque string and never dereferenced to a path or opened. `instances` holds optional explicit object-type rosters (closed-world extension); `facts` maps fact-type ids to arrays of role_name->value mappings.
